findings.evidence: "ANALYTICAL (Axis 3, measurement status) — arithmetic on stated inputs (roofline, KV-residency and capacity screens, the C/W per-host bound and the host counts derived from it)"
findings.issue: The Preface's evidence-discipline definition of ANALYTICAL references "the C/W per-host bound" using symbols C and W that are not defined until Chapter 4 (p.78: "C is reserved throughout the book for a host's KV slot capacity, C≈17.5" and W = mean time in system). A reader encountering an [ANALYTICAL] label in the body and returning to this Preface definition cannot understand the example without having already read Ch. 4.
findings.fix_instruction: Either (a) add a brief inline gloss to the Preface: "the C/W per-host bound (C = per-host KV slot capacity, W = mean service time)" or (b) replace "the C/W per-host bound" with a self-contained phrase such as "the per-host capacity bound."
